failed_and_earlier_phases.initial_witness: Current-head x=0 failure; original source retained and promoted into the stronger vertical corpus.
failed_and_earlier_phases.first_corpus: Tests incorrectly required materialized rational root views and then a zero-width closed fiber count; corrected to exact selected identities and proper isolator counts. Geometry assertions are preserved.
failed_and_earlier_phases.old_finite_test_helper: Legacy audit helper assumes only finite fibers. The unchanged old corpus still uses it; the new vertical witness has separate interval/recomposition audits.
failed_and_earlier_phases.first_downstream: Original BRep fixture expects the old solver error. Its same input now proves solver success and requires the precise later native construction blocker; migration documented.
failed_and_earlier_phases.ccache: Read-only compiler cache prevents initial C++/MSRV builds; disabled cache permits unchanged source.
failed_and_earlier_phases.quota: OS disk quota interrupts minimal compilation, a retention probe link and the combined native run. That output truncates at selected_chord_displacements and the child panic is unavailable. Unchanged six-test retry passes after cleanup; all 19 remaining targets are resumed, with the earlier successful native prefix preserved.
failed_and_earlier_phases.smoke_svg: Assumed full implicit-circle SVG success fails on frozen baseline. Final probe keeps that full input and its reported BudgetExhausted receipt separately; source/outcomes still match. The receipt does not prove its producer actually reached a declared limit.
failed_and_earlier_phases.asan_rational: Earlier 7411-run rational-product grammar. Final 6108-run grammar adds selected quintic columns. Both source/corpus phases remain; LeakSanitizer is disabled.
failed_and_earlier_phases.retention_initial: Temporary auxiliary probe initially warns that its row is unread; final probe explicitly reads the live receipt. Initial warning logs and quota-link failure remain.

limits: Solver topology completion only for new vertical inputs; native curve/BRep construction remains Unsupported. Workspace-path WASM and probes are not release/binding or full CI/pre-push qualification.
